text: Core Content of the MajorThe core of mechanical engineering lies in the study of the design, manufacture, application, and optimization of mechanical systems. Here, "mechanical" not only includes traditional machines such as lathes, automobiles, and construction machinery, but also encompasses high-tech products like robots, precision instruments, medical devices, aerospace equipment, etc. This major conducts research on the structure, motion laws, power transmission, and material selection of machinery to achieve efficient, reliable, and economical operation of mechanical products.
